First Time Setup

This portal uses Google Drive to store data. A one-time setup is needed to connect your Google account and create the COE folder.

1
Sign in with Google (the admin's Google account that owns the Drive)
2
The portal will create a COE folder automatically in your Drive
3
Students log in with their SEN and set their own password — stored securely in Drive

Only the admin needs to do this setup. Students just need a browser.

📋 Google Apps Script — Copy & Deploy Once
1. Go to script.google.com → New Project → paste the code below → Save → Deploy → New Deployment → Web App → Execute as Me → Who has access: Anyone → Deploy → Copy the URL → paste above. 
const PROP_KEY = 'STUDENTS_DATA';

function doGet(e) {
  const action = e.parameter.action;
  if (action === 'ping') return ContentService.createTextOutput('pong').setMimeType(ContentService.MimeType.TEXT);
  if (action === 'load') {
    const data = PropertiesService.getScriptProperties().getProperty(PROP_KEY) || '[]';
    return ContentService.createTextOutput(data).setMimeType(ContentService.MimeType.JSON);
  }
  return ContentService.createTextOutput('[]').setMimeType(ContentService.MimeType.JSON);
}

function doPost(e) {
  try {
    const body = JSON.parse(e.postData.contents);
    if (body.action === 'save' && Array.isArray(body.students)) {
      PropertiesService.getScriptProperties().setProperty(PROP_KEY, JSON.stringify(body.students));
      return ContentService.createTextOutput('ok').setMimeType(ContentService.MimeType.TEXT);
    }
  } catch(err) {}
  return ContentService.createTextOutput('error').setMimeType(ContentService.MimeType.TEXT);
}
